AX Lint
Audit MCP tool interfaces, propose description-only improvements, verify the
agent's first call before applying, and confirm exact deployed metadata.

MCP endpoint: https://fast-pulse-rlqvb.run.mcp-use.com/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP. Public discovery, resources, prompts, audit_server,
and ping require no token and make no generation calls. Full loop and replay
require an Authorization: Bearer named token header. Never put tokens in URLs.
Judges have 5 verify launch attempts per UTC day; polling does not use quota.
The maintainer stores the token only in local .env and Manufact's write-only env.

Why MCP: the coding agent calls AX Lint in its existing repo workflow across
multiple clients. Why an MCP App: the human reviews the verdict, diff, full trials
and confirmation gates inside the same chat.

Core tools: audit_server, propose_patch, verify_patch, get_verification_result,
confirm_patch. Supporting tools: ping, preview_run (recorded S8 replay).
Prompts: improve-agent-experience (URL and source paths), verify-only (URL,
PatchSpec path and frozen tasks path).

Workflow: audit; include all declarations, enums, validation constants, defaults
and handlers in propose_patch; inspect warnings/diff; verify with frozen tasks;
poll to completion. Apply edits only for Improved. Commit/push and wait for target
redeployment; confirm_patch must pass all four gates. Preserve Regressed and
Inconclusive results. Do not change frozen tasks/results or rescore prior runs.
Use AXLINT_MODEL and provider-default sampling; never send temperature.
Scoring v1 is default; future runs may explicitly select v2 for parallel calls.

Provisional: 3 trials per condition. Trackr Sonnet 5.5: Improved 9/12 to 12/12,
returned-result tokens -88.5%, static metadata 651 to 837. Three hosted stability
runs Improved. S8 attempt 1 Regressed 9/12 to 6/12, caught before apply; successful
S8 passed all four confirm gates. Filesystem: Improved 4/9 to 9/9. Separate
Commander.js size check: 1,037,509 to 19,443 full-response tokens. Trackr Haiku 5.5:
6/12 to 12/12, beating Sonnet original 9/12; most per-success cost difference is
Haiku pricing, one model turn only. Memory: both models Inconclusive 9/9 to 9/9.
PopHIVE: Inconclusive 9/12 to 9/12; the coverage chart default resisted the patch.
Yahoo Finance: Inconclusive 8/12 to 9/12; start/end silently ignored. Manufact
Cloud: reviewed privately; results shared with the Manufact team first.
Final hosted judges smoke: Improved 9/12 to 12/12, returned tokens 115,194 to
13,917, static 651 to 955; a separate committed candidate, not the 837-token
frozen compact patch. Details: docs/judges-smoke.md.
Static census: 2,672 public entries, 446 tool snapshots, 432 counts, median 4,018
static tokens, p90 20,431; heuristic flags are not measured behavioral failures.

Runtime: Manufact Cloud + mcp-use, Blaxel shared runner, Trackr on Railway.
Client docs: docs/multi-client.md (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude app,
Inspector; ChatGPT protected loop not supported yet without custom headers).
Method: docs/SPEC.md. Every verdict/evidence: docs/results-summary.md.
Demo: docs/demo.md. Submission: docs/submission.md. Readiness: docs/self-audit.md.
Roadmap: choose models, staging/reset hooks or shadow mode for write tools,
default-change patches, and CI on every pull request. Nothing in private/ leaves
the machine. Never print or commit secrets.
